summary: Truist Financial Corp filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of 500,000 depositary shares representing Series S Fixed Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, with a liquidation preference of $25,000 per share ($1,000 per depositary share). The filing covers amendments to articles of incorporation to establish the preferred stock terms, including dividend restrictions on junior securities if dividends are unpaid. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is described; this is a routine equity issuance.
